host.note: Timings below are CPU-bound work measured in a shared cloud Linux VM with no GPU (software rasterisation). They are valid as RELATIVE, CPU-only comparisons between approaches on the SAME host. They are NOT mid-range-laptop or iPad numbers and must never be reported as such.

decidability_finding: PMTiles is a transport/packaging format for VECTOR (or raster) tiles consumed by a vector renderer. The production app uses Leaflet with RASTER basemap tiles and whole-GeoJSON overlays; it has no vector-tile renderer. PMTiles for the overlays is therefore NOT decidable independently of the MapLibre decision (§3): adopting PMTiles for ámbito/licence vectors presupposes a vector renderer. Verdict is slaved to MapLibre's.
transfer_model_note: TODAY each overlay is fetched once as a whole gzipped GeoJSON and cached. PMTiles would fetch only the tiles overlapping the viewport, via HTTP range requests on one .pmtiles file. At Madrid-municipal extent and the app's default zoom, the whole ámbito layer is visible, so PMTiles would transfer a comparable byte volume on first paint; its win is at deep zoom over a much larger corpus (parcel scale), which this product does not have.
